page.title: Become a host
page.subtitle: Create a shop to list and manage your rental vehicles. XePrime reviews your shop profile before your vehicles go live on the marketplace.
page.homeAriaLabel: Go to the XePrime home page

steps.create: Create the shop: name, business type, province and contacts.
steps.complete: Complete the profile, then press Submit for review — XePrime only looks at it once you submit.
steps.prepare: While you wait, you can already add vehicles and get your data ready.
steps.publish: Once approved: your vehicles go live on the marketplace and you start taking bookings.

form.title: Create your shop
form.intro: This step only creates a draft. Next you will land on your shop profile to finish the details and submit for review.

province.label: Province / city
province.help: Where your first branch sits — customers will find your vehicles in this province.
province.empty: No province is open for registration yet — please contact support.
province.loadError: Could not load the province list

tips.title: Good to know
tips.accuracy: Accurate details get your profile approved faster.
tips.editable: Everything here can be changed after the shop is created.

privacy.title: Your data is safe
privacy.body: Your details are kept private and used only to verify your shop.
